source.paper: Universal CT Representations from Anatomy to Disease Phenotype through Agglomerative Pretraining
source.native_probe_section: Supplement S0.17; 3D phenotype frozen-feature linear probing

fixed_parameters.feature_standardization: StandardScaler fit on training partition only

search_space.candidate_construction: one complete publication-backed C sweep per development percentage

task_adaptations.original_task: lesion-centred 32/64 voxel phenotype crops with repeated stratified CV
task_adaptations.current_task: five mutually exclusive whole-volume abdominal CT classes with fixed patient folds
task_adaptations.whole_volume_preprocessing_source: official FlexiCT CT-RATE VLM evaluation code: LPS, 2 mm, 160 cubed, HU clipping and volume z-score
task_adaptations.feature_recipe: frozen VLM vision backbone; concat normalized CLS and mean normalized patch tokens; frozen 1728-to-1024 VLM projection; L2 normalization
task_adaptations.selection: project robust macro-F1/balanced-accuracy score; held-out patients excluded
